what: published push-rule 6T bitcells by node: the array's node scale sigma(n)

range_nm.derivation: rule B: the smallest and largest node with a published push-rule 6T cell

interpolation: log-log between the reference cells of the adjacent nodes inside the range
outside_range: a named refusal unless the description declares its own bitcell with a citation

lifting_figures.below the range: a published 3 nm (or Intel 4) push-rule 6T bitcell area
lifting_figures.above the range: a published 90 nm or 130 nm push-rule 6T bitcell area

reference.derivation: rule A: the reference push-rule 6T cell at the node, the geometric mean of the node's published cells (each alike)

held_out.rule: every fitted value is re-derived with the held-out chip's entries removed (by id prefix); a point that reads one is dropped, a point that meets a named refusal is dropped by name
held_out.record: the toolchain's held-out estimate (area_rule/parity.py; tests T-6, T-27)
